Q&A for mobile card monsters:

Q:Why players can not create their own character name while applied a random ID?
A:Because of lacking account system，we set players’ ID randomly when they first launch the game. ID Customization will be considered later on.

Q: Why there is no Tutorial in the game?
A: Since Card Monsters is still under Beta test，some primary features have not launched yet. Based on the basic process，every main gameplay should has its relative tutorial，so the whole game tutorial will be ready after these features launched.

Q:Why there are some parts are locked in the game? Such as castles，shops，etc..
A:Because those parts are still under developing. Hopefully to unlock them

Q:Why we can’t get extra booster card packs except 5 packs per 12 hours?
A:We are developing other functions for players to get more packs. There will variety ways for players to get packs then.

Q:Why we can’t get EXP/coins/materials by winning battles now?
A:We truly know that players want to level up themselves and win stronger opponents. We are not sure what kind of systems will be online，such as role players level systems or EXP systems.
